results.evidence: The Forest Service's Killen Creek trailhead page says no fees are required for the site (only the Mt Adams Climbing Pass above 7,000 ft and a free wilderness permit), and an independent backpacking guide lists the trailhead pass as none required; one hiking guide still lists a Northwest Forest Pass, but the land manager's own page settles it. Two hiking guides give the trailhead-to-High Camp climb as 2,300 ft and 2,315 ft to a 6,900 ft high point, matching the row's own approach text, so day 1's 2,900 ft gain and day 3's 2,900 ft loss are corrected to 2,300. Two sources give about 17 mi round trip for the route, but none states the camp-to-summit-and-back distance or gain, so day 2's 4 mi and 3,300 ft are left rather than replaced with a computed number (nulling them would make the trip TOTAL read lower still).
